rows.q: A train travels at 80 kilometers per hour for 3 hours. How far does it go?
rows.text: It travels 240 kilometers.

rows.q: How long does it take to drive 150 miles at 50 miles an hour?
rows.text: 3 hours — 150 miles ÷ 50 miles an hour.
